description: Tonyd2wild multi-stream engine bundled at 1758bc2d, based on Mia’s TensorFold 0.6.0 patches, with Brandonmusic EXL3 tr3-4bpw and incoai DFlash2. 4 ranks, 8 streams and 500,000-token context per request; FP8 KV, q4 dense matrices, vision and adaptive MTP/DFlash. The creator’s unpublished local image is replaced by a pinned NGC CUDA base plus the exact bundled engine and locked dependencies. Controller placement supplies rank and fabric identities instead of creator-specific SSH/NFS addresses. Memory is an estimate; upstream benchmark results are not local physical qualification.
title: GLM-5.3 Flash EXL3 TensorFold four Spark (tonyd2wild)
